leah: Quick async — can owners confirm status on dashboards / tracing hooks / error-analysis views / retention milestone for console observability? Need blockers for Thursday milestone. TL;DR please. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: Tracing hooks — I'm blocked by svc-auth schema change. PR #4521 needs review. If merged, hooks rollout automated. ETA 2d.

raj: Dashboards — 80% done. Waiting on final event names from infra team (schema v2). Can fill with placeholders for canary dashboard by Wed.

maria: Retention — We're targeting 90 days for traces and 365 for metrics. Need legal signoff for 365 on metrics retention (PII check). Pinged compliance yesterday.

toni: Error analysis views — landed prototype in staging. Need sample error labels from SRE to build grouping rules. Posting link: https://staging.redwood/errview/px

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary tracing-hooks -> prod on 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC (depends on PR merge)

leah: Action items: (1) Sam -> add checklist to PR and tag @raj for event names (2) Raj -> create canary dashboard with placeholders and add query examples (3) Maria -> update retention doc with compliance note and timeline (4) Toni -> add SRE label examples in thread

sam: Adding checklist now. Also question — if schema change delayed, can we ship hooks without enriched user_id? yes but with limited correlation. Will note in rollout playbook.

raj: I'll make a minimal dashboard and post link by EOD. Need a sample query: `service="console" AND span.kind="server"`

maria: Compliance says 3 business days for review. If they need more, propose we ship 90-day traces first and extend later.

toni: @sre-team can you drop 5 example error labels in this thread? e.g., AuthTimeout, KVWriteErr, RenderNPE

sre1: AuthTimeout

sre2: KVWriteErr

sre3: RenderNPE

sre4: DBConnReset

sre5: CacheMissHotkey

leah: Great — thanks. I'll compile and send to PMs. If anything blocks the Thursday milestone, flag now. :eyes:

sam: PR #4521 -> checklist + tag done. link: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4521

raj: Canary dashboard link: https://dashboards.redwood/c/223/canary-console-obsv (placeholder panels)
